name: Heavy Is Our Crown
source:
Prince Murad is getting married in three days to a woman he has never met. Everyone assures him that she is beautiful.

Darin's marriage is coming to a painful end. He has assured misery and loneliness for everyone.

In their bedrooms, there is a mirror.

The reflection of a prince with regal antlers sees a tired old man look back; The reflection of a tired old man sees a prince with regal antlers look forward.

[From [url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/heavy-is-our-crown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三天后，穆拉德王子将与一位他从未见过的女人结婚。每个人都向他保证她很漂亮。

达林的婚姻即将迎来痛苦的结局。他给每个人带来了痛苦和孤独。

他们的卧室里有一面镜子。

一位长着鹿角的王子的倒影让一​​位疲倦的老人回头望去；一个疲惫的老人的倒影看到了一位带着王者鹿角的王子向前看。

[来自[url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/heavy-is-our-crown]itch.io[/url]]
